title: Pallet Trail
brief: A customer of Meridian Logistics reports that pallet {{pal}} arrived 18 cases short. You need to trace the pallet from receiving through storage, picking, loading, and delivery, and define what else is affected. You have 12 visit points.

actions.label: General condition of the area
actions.note: Nothing of note for the purpose of this visit.

actions.label: A staff member: anything else to mention
actions.note: The staff member has nothing further to add on this topic.

actions.label: Other pallets on the same trailer
Older records for this area
actions.note: The older records show nothing relevant to this visit.

actions.label: Notices and signs in the area
actions.note: The notices are current and not relevant to this visit.

evidence.text: Inbound record shows the stock received complete with batch codes.
Location history for the stock is complete.
Stock adjustment SA-771 removed 18 cases from the pick location 2 days before picking with the reason "system".
evidence.whyItMatters: Changes to stock records must be explained and authorized.

evidence.text: Pick record for {{pal}} shows 120 cases confirmed by keyed entry, not scan.
evidence.whyItMatters: Pick confirmation should verify what was picked.

evidence.text: Pallet scale PS-2 used for weight check was 4 weeks past verification.
Load check LC-405 for the trailer records weight variance 9 percent; release limit 3 percent; signed as released.
evidence.whyItMatters: Release must follow passed checks or authorization.

evidence.text: 4 other pallets on the same trailer were picked by keyed entry in the same hour; no check has been made with those customers (trailer TR-88).
evidence.whyItMatters: Containment covers output produced the same way.
evidence.missedExplanation: Look at other output from the same conditions.

evidence.text: Proof of delivery is signed with a note of shortage.
Supervisor: "We look at weight variance only if someone raises it." (note 2)
evidence.whyItMatters: Proactive review of variances would catch shortages.

evidence.text: Wrapping film is blue instead of clear.
Trailer seal log shows the seal intact on arrival.
evidence.whyItMatters: Conforming; rules out theft in transit.

decisions.prompt: What is the scope of review?
options: {{pal}}, the 4 other pallets keyed in the same hour on trailer TR-88, and any load checked on scale PS-2 since its last verification
decisions.rationale: Keyed picks, the unexplained adjustment, and the overdue scale widen the scope.

containment: Contact the 4 other customers and review loads checked on PS-2
correction: Ship the 18 missing cases and correct stock records
cause: Unexplained adjustments allowed, keyed picks accepted, and load variances released without authorization
corrective: Require reasons and approval for adjustments, limit keyed picks, and block release above variance limits
effectiveness: Track shortage complaints and variance releases for three months

debriefText.found: You traced the pallet through each stage.
debriefText.missed: Check other pallets from the same hour and trailer.
debriefText.falseFinding: Film color and an intact seal are not findings.
